From 8bd719587d1215dad42d48d725eb1858987112c8 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Marta Lofstedt <marta.lofstedt@intel.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Aug 2017 15:18:10 +0300
Subject: [PATCH] drm/i915: Beef up of Beef up the IPS vs. CRC workaround
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

Commit 6e644626945c ("drm/i915: Beef up the IPS vs. CRC
workaround") was supposed to solve below bug. However, the
patch I tested is not the same as the one that got merged.
With this addition the test pass.

V2: removed unused: "struct intel_crtc *intel_crtc"

Fixes: 6e644626945c ("drm/i915: Beef up the IPS vs. CRC workaround")
Bugzilla: https://bugs.freedesktop.org/show_bug.cgi?id=101664
Signed-off-by: Marta Lofstedt <marta.lofstedt@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Ville Syrjälä <ville.syrjala@linux.intel.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20170828121810.13112-1-marta.lofstedt@intel.com

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_pipe_crc.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_pipe_crc.c
index 4e22bb927fed..96043a51c1bf 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_pipe_crc.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_pipe_crc.c
@@ -919,7 +919,6 @@ int intel_crtc_set_crc_source(struct drm_crtc *crtc, const char *source_name,
 {
 	struct drm_i915_private *dev_priv = crtc->dev->dev_private;
 	struct intel_pipe_crc *pipe_crc = &dev_priv->pipe_crc[crtc->index];
-	struct intel_crtc *intel_crtc = to_intel_crtc(crtc);
 	enum intel_display_power_domain power_domain;
 	enum intel_pipe_crc_source source;
 	u32 val = 0; /* shut up gcc */
@@ -951,8 +950,6 @@ int intel_crtc_set_crc_source(struct drm_crtc *crtc, const char *source_name,
 		else if ((IS_HASWELL(dev_priv) ||
 			  IS_BROADWELL(dev_priv)) && crtc->index == PIPE_A)
 			hsw_pipe_A_crc_wa(dev_priv, false);
-
-		hsw_enable_ips(intel_crtc);
 	}
 
 	pipe_crc->skipped = 0;
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/i915/intel_pipe_crc.c`**
   - **Removed Line**: The line that initializes `struct intel_crtc *intel_crtc` has been removed. This variable was not used in the function.
   - **Removed Function Call**: The call to `hsw_enable_ips(intel_crtc);` has also been removed, which suggests that the enabling of IPS (Intelligent Power Saving) for the Intel CRTC (Cathode Ray Tube Controller) is no longer performed in this context.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications made in the `intel_pipe_crc.c` file are aimed at cleaning up the code by removing unused variables and function calls. The removal of the `intel_crtc` variable and the `hsw_enable_ips` function call indicates a refinement of the workaround for the IPS vs. CRC issue, which was initially addressed in a previous commit (6e644626945c). The changes suggest that the workaround has been adjusted to be more efficient or correct, as the original implementation may have included unnecessary components that did not contribute to solving the bug. The patch is a follow-up to ensure that the workaround is effective without extraneous code.

        Root cause:
        The bug was related to the interaction between the Intelligent Power Saving (IPS) feature and the CRC (Cyclic Redundancy Check) functionality in the Intel graphics driver. The original workaround implemented in commit 6e644626945c may not have effectively addressed the issue, leading to failures in tests that relied on proper CRC functionality when IPS was enabled. The removal of unused code and the specific function call indicates that the previous implementation was not optimal and could have introduced unnecessary complexity or incorrect behavior.
